build: macOS arm64, Rust 1.99.0, private worktree target, debug without incremental compilation or debug info; source overlays refresh mtimes. Python artist consumer also verified on Linux.

fixture.inputs: Synthetic two-point 64x64 image and independent 1-Jy component model; eight 12-m ALMA pads; 230 GHz, 1 GHz width, four 10-second integrations. Dense hexagonal 16-arcsec map at 1-arcsec spacing has 279 pointings. Single-dish image control included. The committed recipe records actual installed CASA Matplotlib artists.

commands: RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 CASA_RS_GRAPHICS_DEBUG_DIR=OUT cargo test -p casa-simulation --test simobserve_quick_psf -- --nocapture
cargo clippy -p casa-ms -p casa-task-runtime -p casa-simulation -p casars-simulation -p casars-python --all-targets -- -D warnings
RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test -p casa-ms -p casa-task-runtime -p casa-simulation -p casars-simulation -p casars-python --no-fail-fast

comparison.coverage: One and three CPU workers for all four cases; every line sample, image pixel, circle, anchored beam legend, annotation, limits and checked visible style. All 279 dense pointings retained; no thinning.
comparison.exact: Panel/artist counts, titles and axis labels, aspect, frame visibility, marker/line style and width, image origin/interpolation/colormap, circle fill/width, annotation text.
comparison.transport: Typed native documents plus caller-owned file of raw little-endian arrays; validated shape/stride/extent and file bounds before plotting. NumPy views read without JSON/base64 pixel copies; NumPy owns mapping lifetime.

numerical_psf.backend_note: Actual Metal-session prediction is exercised; the small diagnostic PSF itself uses CPU/f64 as recorded in the quick-PSF receipt.

task_process: Real Python task process passes file/screen/both/none tests, expected product completion, relative project paths and deletion of its private payload directory. Atomic PNG publication preserves a previous output on failure.

review.reviewer: One fresh-context Astra xhigh review as required by AGENTS.md; no re-review.
findings: P2: an orphan pending artifact with no figure could report a stale PNG as newly created.
P2: failure during figure construction leaked its newly registered figure.
review.regressions: Both findings reproduced before fixes and pass afterward. Additional artist-exception regression proves a captured view retains a live NumPy-owned mapping; previous raw mmap close left that mapping closed.

full_touched_rust.command: RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test -p casa-ms -p casa-task-runtime -p casa-simulation -p casars-simulation -p casars-python --no-fail-fast

post_review_editable_python.environment_note: Two earlier unrelated fake-executable tests failed because sys.executable contained a space, making generated shebangs invalid. The same package/dependencies and the rebuilt package pass from a physical no-space interpreter path.

verification.all_target_clippy: passed for the five touched crates after review fixes
verification.architecture: All preceding checks pass; untouched casa-imaging-operator/tests/resample.rs exceeds the file limit (tracked #1253).
verification.other_main_blocker: Two unchanged imaging-application MVC assertions are independently tracked in #1262; this renderer changes no imaging-application source.

MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS=--profile dev CARGO_TARGET_DIR=FRESH pip install SDIST[test,plot]; pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test_binding_snapshots.py test_parameters.py test_data.py test_plot_document.py
packaged_python.isolation: Non-editable installs tested outside the checkout; casars, casars._core and casars._plot_document origins verified under their respective environments. The sdist uses a fresh independent Cargo target, with no artifact reuse. Equivalent manual commands were used on the source archive because the repository wrappers require git metadata.

limits: Artist/data equivalence and successful PNG generation are verified; raster bit identity across Matplotlib/font versions is not claimed.

The fixture uses hourangle=35s for the approved TAI/UTC labeling alignment. The bounded plot differences are at most 8.59899e-4 hours (about 3.1 seconds), 6.07e-5 degrees elevation and 5.31e-4 kilolambda. This plot fixture does not establish equal-stored-TIME MS/UVW parity; that is checked separately by the task receipts.
Rendering requires the Python host and plot extra. A direct headless task without the caller payload still warns that PNG rendering needs the host.
Public simutil plotting methods, other simulation mode/parameter combinations and full #1053 acceptance remain open.
Debug correctness runs do not establish performance or whole-task memory acceptance.
